description: Defines the SSEStreamer class for managing server-sent events (SSE) clients and streaming various event types over HTTP responses.

classes.name: SSEStreamer
classes.description: Implements server-sent event streaming, managing clients and broadcasting different event types.

methods.name: addExternalClient
methods.description: Adds an external client to the SSE streamer with a specific chat ID and response object.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Adds an internal client to the SSE streamer with a specific chat ID and response object.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes a client by chat ID, sending an 'end' event before cleanup.

methods.name: streamCustomEvent
methods.description: Streams a custom event with specified type and data to a client.

methods.name: streamStartEvent
methods.description: Streams a 'start' event to a client if not already started.

methods.name: streamTokenEvent
methods.description: Streams a 'token' event with data.

methods.name: streamSourceDocumentsEvent
methods.description: Streams source documents event with data.

methods.name: streamArtifactsEvent
methods.description: Streams artifacts event with data.

methods.name: streamUsedToolsEvent
methods.description: Streams used tools event with data.

methods.name: streamCalledToolsEvent
methods.description: Streams called tools event with data.

methods.name: streamFileAnnotationsEvent
methods.description: Streams file annotations event with data.

methods.name: streamToolEvent
methods.description: Streams tool event with data.

methods.name: streamAgentReasoningEvent
methods.description: Streams agent reasoning event with data.

methods.name: streamNextAgentEvent
methods.description: Streams next agent event with data.

methods.name: streamAgentFlowEvent
methods.description: Streams agent flow event with data.

methods.name: streamAgentFlowExecutedDataEvent
methods.description: Streams agent flow executed data event.

methods.name: streamNextAgentFlowEvent
methods.description: Streams next agent flow event.

methods.name: streamActionEvent
methods.description: Streams an action event with data.

methods.name: streamAbortEvent
methods.description: Streams an abort event indicating completion.

methods.name: streamEndEvent
methods.description: Placeholder for future use.

methods.name: streamErrorEvent
methods.description: Streams an error event, with special handling for API key errors.

methods.name: streamMetadataEvent
methods.description: Streams metadata event with optional fields from API response.

methods.name: streamUsageMetadataEvent
methods.description: Streams usage metadata event.

methods.name: streamTTSStartEvent
methods.description: Streams TTS start event with chat message ID and format.

methods.name: streamTTSDataEvent
methods.description: Streams TTS data chunk.

methods.name: streamTTSEndEvent
methods.description: Streams TTS end event.

methods.name: streamTTSAbortEvent
methods.description: Streams TTS abort event and ends the client response.
